competences.description: Attacks with a graceful touch and possesses the enemy with a 30% chance to increase the enemy's chances to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Throws a fan to attack the enemy 3 times, with each attack having a 50% chance to remove one of the enemy's beneficial effects. Increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 15% each per beneficial effect removed. The damage is proportionate to the attack speed.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Recovers the HP of all allies with a mysterious dance and extends the time of the beneficial effects and shortens the time of the harmful effects. The recovery amount is in proportion to the Attack Power.

effets.description: Increases the duration of a buff by a number of turns.
Decreases the duration of debuffs by a number of turns.
